definitions.explanation: Software or hardware that stores the keys used to hold, send, and receive digital money or cryptocurrency. Also used for smartphone payment apps that store electronic money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗号資産|あんごうしさん}→暗号資産：16614_angoushisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ウォレット⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: I store my crypto assets in a wallet.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ウォレット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I paid using the wallet on my smartphone.

examples.japanese: ウォレット⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}せなく→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you forget your wallet password, you can no longer recover your assets.

notes:
From English "wallet." In digital and crypto contexts it refers to the app, service, or device that holds the keys to your funds, not to a physical billfold (⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウォレット⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to store (assets) in a wallet
- モバイルウォレット: mobile wallet
- ⟦ハードウェア→ハードウェア：05151_haadowea⟧ウォレット: hardware wallet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: wallet; purse — the physical object for cash and cards
- ⟦{電子|でんし}マネー→電子マネー：06694_denshimanee⟧: electronic money — the stored value itself, not the wallet that holds it
